name: Authme 7.1.2
body:
### Authme 7.1.2

* 2026.10.30. (Hotfix update)

### Security

* Fixed the encryption key used in "No authentication" mode. Codes are re-encrypted with a new random key the first time you open this version [GHSA-7gh2-g335-m5pc](https://github.com/Levminer/authme/security/advisories/GHSA-7gh2-g335-m5pc)
* Fixed a possible XSS through code names and issuers in the codes, edit and export pages [GHSA-px5p-jf62-2899](https://github.com/Levminer/authme/security/advisories/GHSA-px5p-jf62-2899)
* Stricter Content Security Policy and reduced file system permissions

### Bug

* Fixed Authme failing to save the encryption key on Linux, especially inside Flatpak #369

### Improvement

* Updated Tauri and other packages
